title.zh: CoQ 国际象棋·围棋棋钟

description.en: The whole half-screen is the button. Fischer increment, Bronstein delay, byoyomi and sudden death — built for a phone lying flat between two players, and it keeps running offline.
description.zh: 整块半屏就是按钮：Fischer 加秒、Bronstein 延时、读秒与包干四种模式。手机平放在两位棋手之间就能开一局，断网也照常走。

imageAlt.en: The clock mid-game in facing mode
imageAlt.zh: 对局中的棋钟（对坐模式）

description.en: Load any SGF and walk its variations on a 13×13 board, annotate as you go, and keep the game tree, comments and score in one window. The browser build runs offline; the desktop app adds GTP engines and native file dialogs.
description.zh: 读入任意 SGF，在 13×13 棋盘上逐手浏览变化、随手写批注，棋谱分支、注释与形势判断都在同一个窗口里。浏览器版可离线使用，桌面版另有 GTP 引擎与原生文件对话框。

imageAlt.en: MultiGo Neo showing a 13×13 game with the move tree
imageAlt.zh: MultiGo Neo 正在复盘一局 13 路棋，右侧是分支树
